newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Celtech corrects EPS, dividend forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Celtech corrects EPS, dividend forecasts.

text.p: Celtron Technologies said on Thursday that an error had been made in the company's condensed pre-listing statement in earnings and dividend projections.

The correct figures, as contained in the full pre-listing statement, should have read that earnings for the year to end September were forecast at 13.04 cents a share rising to 70.18 cents in 1998, with a dividend of 3.91 cents this year rising to 21.05 cents next year.

The statement issued on Wednesday had forecast earnings for the year to end September at 13.46 cents a share rising to 70.83 cents in 1998, and a dividend of 4.04 cents this year rising to 21.25 cents next.
Celtech shares made a firm debut on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Wednesday, hitting a high of 470 cents before closing at 370.
